scope: Kubernetes v1.36.1 Pod CREATE admission in three synthetic namespaces. Uses server-side dry-run only for harmless Pods missing only the Restricted allowPrivilegeEscalation=false and capabilities.drop=[ALL] settings. Confirms native namespace and RuntimeClass exemptions, then checks a synthetic ValidatingAdmissionPolicy allows only the exact named Pod, ServiceAccount, label, namespace and (for the RuntimeClass arm) class. Two authenticated requester identities test username scoping with the same harmless dry-run. Real infrastructure workloads, runtime execution and controller-created Pods require additional evidence. The real audit backend records the selected workload write and Metadata for empty Secret creation. Updates, production RBAC/namespace governance, and compensating-control effectiveness beyond this exact identity check are out of scope.
